records.text: In 2013, Arizona House Judiciary Committee chair Eddie Farnsworth blocked a hearing on a bipartisan bill intended to combat child sex trafficking.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Eddie Farnsworth was as I said the chair of the House Judiciary Committee And he caused a bit of a kerfluffle in the state because for some unknown reason, he blocked a hearing on a bill to prevent child sex trafficking.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting and an Arizona Law Review analysis identify Eddie Farnsworth as the committee chair who denied HB2569 a hearing despite bipartisan support.

sources.title: Eddie Farnsworth Blocked Hearing for Anti-Child-Sex-Trafficking Bill
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous reporting states that Judiciary chair Eddie Farnsworth blocked a hearing for bipartisan trafficking bill HB 2569.
